metadata.title: Rustic Duo Portrait with Circular Graphic Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of two men standing beneath a weathered wooden pier structure, framed by a thick sepia-toned border. The composition features a central circular typographic emblem that overlaps both subjects, creating a focal point between them. The lighting is natural but moody, with a heavy dark vignette around the edges.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical balance between two male subjects
Contrast between the sharp, white graphic and the textured, organic background
Framing effect created by the wooden pilings and the outer border
Linear perspective provided by the receding pier supports
coreInvariants: Heavy dark vignette inside the border

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two male subjects occupy the left and right thirds of the frame, scaled from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central circular logo acts as the primary anchor, bridging the gap between the two subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central logo, move outward to the faces of the subjects, then follow the pier lines into the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The space between the two men is filled by the graphic and the receding background perspective.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted earth tones (browns, greys, and tans) in the background and border.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the clothing and vignette provide structural weight.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white and light grey in the central graphic and one subject's shirt.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white graphic and dark clothing.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, blocky sans-serif with geometric leanings
letterConstructionRules: Angled terminals that follow the circular boundary
Heavy black drop shadow to create depth against the background
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are warped and sheared to fit within a circular frame
Horizontal bars are extended to connect adjacent characters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single complex graphic mark without secondary text.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary blocky weight for customization
Required to achieve the specific circular warp and interlocking fit

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of two men standing under a wooden pier. The man on the left wears a black button-down; the man on the right wears a blue v-neck under a dark blazer. The background shows the receding perspective of wooden pilings. Apply a heavy dark vignette and frame the entire image with a thick, textured sepia-toned border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Create a circular logo using thick, white, blocky custom lettering stacked in three rows. The text should be warped to fit perfectly inside a double-ring circle. Add a hard black drop shadow to the logo and place it in the center of the image, overlapping the space between the two men.

verificationChecks: Is the logo centered and circular?
Does the sepia border have a parchment texture?
Are the subjects framed by the pier pilings?
Is the vignette strong enough to darken the corners significantly?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the sepia border texture
Specific clothing styles of the duo
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the individuals
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is contained within the circle
Check that the border does not overlap the subjects
Verify the perspective of the pier pilings looks natural
Confirm the drop shadow on the logo provides sufficient separation
recipe.reuseFormula: Rustic Portrait + Circular Block Typography + Sepia Frame + Heavy Vignette
